tasks.name: Employer and Beneficiary Documentation Gathering
tasks.description: Collect all necessary documents from both the employer and the beneficiary. This includes the job offer letter, employment contract, corporate registration papers, and evidence that the beneficiary meets the position’s qualifications.

tasks.name: Form I‑129 Completion and Supporting Evidence Assembly
tasks.description: Accurately complete Form I‑129 by incorporating precise details about the job, the employer, and the beneficiary’s background. Attach supporting evidence like educational credentials and past work experience documents to reinforce the petition.

tasks.name: Fee Processing and Application Package Preparation
tasks.description: Review the USCIS fee requirements, process the appropriate payment, and ensure that all necessary supporting paperwork is organized according to USCIS guidelines. Careful assembly of the package minimizes the likelihood of delays due to formatting issues.

tasks.name: Final Review and Submission
tasks.description: Perform a detailed, final check of the entire application packet for accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Confirm that all documents are signed and compiled in the correct order before submitting the package via approved delivery methods.

tasks.name: Post‑Submission Tracking and RFE Preparedness
tasks.description: After submission, monitor the case status using the USCIS online tracking system and prepare to respond quickly if a Request for Evidence (RFE) is issued. Keep all copies of the submission and stay in contact with legal advisors for any necessary follow‑up actions.

tasks.name: Petitioner and Beneficiary Docs Gathering
tasks.description: Gather petitioner's proof of U.S. citizenship and beneficiary's personal documents.

tasks.name: Relationship Evidence Compilation
tasks.description: Compile evidence of bona fide relationship and meeting in person within the last two years.

tasks.name: Form I-129F Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-129F with all required details about both parties.

tasks.name: Package Assembly and Submission
tasks.description: Assemble final package with photos, G-1145, and filing fee. Submit to USCIS.

tasks.name: Track Case and Prepare for Interview
tasks.description: Track case status and prepare beneficiary for consular interview.

tasks.name: Eligibility Review and Supporting Document Collection
tasks.description: Confirm that the beneficiary meets eligibility criteria for an Employment Authorization Document (EAD) and gather documents such as current I‑94 records, passport copies, and previous work permits. Clear evidence of status is essential to support the application.

tasks.name: Form I‑765 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I‑765 accurately, ensuring that all personal and status-related information matches the supporting documentation. Emphasize clarity and consistency to reduce travel time and potential requests for clarifications by USCIS.

tasks.name: Compiling and Organizing the Supporting Materials
tasks.description: Assemble documents like identification proofs, photographs, and copies of previous EADs or immigration documentation into a coherent package. This step ensures that USCIS receives a well‑organized file that expedites processing.

tasks.name: Fee Verification and Payment Coordination
tasks.description: Verify if a fee is required and prepare for payment using the accepted methods. Double‑check USCIS guidelines to avoid any miscalculations and ensure that all payment proofs are included in the submission.

tasks.name: Final Package Review and Submission
tasks.description: Conduct a comprehensive review of the complete application package with a focus on verifying all entries and attachments. Once assured that all parts are consistent and complete, submit the application and retain copies for your records.

tasks.name: Determine Necessity
tasks.description: Confirm if I-765WS is required (e.g., for C(8) or C(33) EAD categories).

tasks.name: Gather Financial Information
tasks.description: Collect personal financial information (income, assets, expenses).

tasks.name: Form I-765WS Completion
tasks.description: Complete the worksheet to demonstrate economic necessity.

tasks.name: Attach to Form I-765
tasks.description: Attach the completed worksheet to the main Form I-765 application.

tasks.name: Relationship Evidence Collection
tasks.description: Gather all essential documents to substantiate the familial relationship between the petitioner and the alien relative. Typical evidence includes birth certificates, marriage certificates, photographs, and correspondence proving a bona fide relationship.

tasks.name: Form I‑130 Completion
tasks.description: Fill out Form I‑130 ensuring that every detail—personal data, relationship history, and supporting specifics—is accurate and consistent with the evidentiary documents. This careful entry minimizes processing delays related to discrepancies.

tasks.name: Fee Processing and Package Assembly
tasks.description: Determine the correct filing fee and prepare the payment as per USCIS guidelines. Assemble the completed form along with the evidence into a complete package ready for submission.

tasks.name: Final Review and Submission
tasks.description: Perform a detailed review of the entire packet to ensure the documentation is complete, well‑organized, and error‑free. Once confirmed, submit the packet using the recommended mailing or courier method and secure tracking details.

tasks.name: Post‑Submission Monitoring and Response Preparation
tasks.description: Monitor the case regularly through the USCIS website and be prepared to address any Requests for Evidence promptly. Maintaining open channels with legal counsel can help ensure quick responses if additional documentation is required.

tasks.name: Beneficiary Info Gathering
tasks.description: Collect spouse beneficiary's biographic information and 5-year address/employment history.

tasks.name: Form I-130A Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-130A. This form is completed by the spouse beneficiary.

tasks.name: Review and Sign
tasks.description: Review form for accuracy and obtain beneficiary's signature.

tasks.name: Package with I-130
tasks.description: Combine signed I-130A with the main I-130 petition package for submission.

tasks.name: Personal Narrative and Evidence Compilation
tasks.description: Collect detailed personal narratives, affidavits, and documentary evidence that support the claim for asylum. This includes country condition reports, personal records, and witness testimonies that detail persecution or fear of persecution.

tasks.name: Form I‑589 Completion
tasks.description: Fill out Form I‑589 comprehensively, ensuring that every section accurately reflects the applicant’s personal background and reasons for seeking asylum. The form should be supported by evidence from the gathered documents to bolster the claim.

tasks.name: Expert Consultations and Affidavit Collection
tasks.description: Arrange consultations with experienced immigration attorneys or human rights experts, and obtain expert affidavits and witness statements to support the asylum case. These documents add credibility and depth to the personal narrative by including independent validations.

tasks.name: Comprehensive Package Review and Finalization
tasks.description: Conduct a thorough review of the entire application package, ensuring that the narrative, evidentiary documents, expert opinions, and form entries are all aligned and error‑free. Make any necessary revisions and compile the final packet in the order mandated by USCIS guidelines.

tasks.name: Interview Preparation and Post‑Submission Follow‑Up
tasks.description: Prepare for the asylum interview by reviewing potential questions and organizing all documents in an accessible format. Stay informed about the case status and be ready to provide additional evidence or clarification as requested during the USCIS process.

tasks.name: Eligibility Verification and Document Collection
tasks.description: Confirm eligibility for naturalization by reviewing continuous residence, physical presence, and good moral character requirements. Gather essential documents, including your Green Card, tax records, travel history, and marital history documentation.

tasks.name: Form N-400 Application Completion
tasks.description: Carefully complete Form N-400, ensuring all personal history, residence, employment, and travel information is accurate and matches your supporting documents. Pay close attention to the questions regarding good moral character.

tasks.name: Supporting Evidence Compilation and Biometrics Prep
tasks.description: Organize all supporting evidence, such as tax transcripts, residence proofs, and photos, into a clear and logical package. Prepare for the biometrics appointment, which is a standard part of the process.

tasks.name: Comprehensive Review and Application Submission
tasks.description: Conduct a final, thorough review of the entire N-400 application package to check for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Submit the application to the correct USCIS lockbox and keep a full copy for your records.

tasks.name: Civics Test Study and Interview Preparation
tasks.description: After submission, begin studying for the U.S. civics and English tests. Monitor your case status online and prepare for the naturalization interview by reviewing your application and practicing your answers to potential questions.

tasks.name: Determine Document Type
tasks.description: Identify need: Re-entry Permit, Refugee Travel Document, or Advance Parole.

tasks.name: Gather Supporting Docs
tasks.description: Collect copy of Green Card, I-485 receipt, or refugee/asylee status proof.

tasks.name: Form I-131 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-131, including reason for travel and intended dates.

tasks.name: Biometrics Prep and Submission
tasks.description: Submit application with fee and photos. Prepare for biometrics appointment.

tasks.name: PERM Labor Certification Approval
tasks.description: Obtain approved PERM Labor Certification (if required).

tasks.name: Employer Financials and Beneficiary Docs
tasks.description: Gather employer's ability to pay (tax returns, annual reports) and beneficiary's qualifications.

tasks.name: Form I-140 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-140, selecting the correct employment-based category.

tasks.name: Package Assembly and Submission
tasks.description: Assemble petition with PERM, financials, and beneficiary documents. Submit to USCIS.

tasks.name: Track and Consider Premium Processing
tasks.description: Track case status. Consider and file for Premium Processing (I-907) if needed.

tasks.name: Determine Eligibility Basis
tasks.description: Confirm eligibility (e.g., VAWA, religious worker, SIJ).

tasks.name: Gather Basis-Specific Evidence
tasks.description: Collect specific evidence required for the basis (e.g., proof of abuse, religious organization letter).

tasks.name: Form I-360 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-360 with all details related to the specific category.

tasks.name: Final Review and Submission
tasks.description: Review package for completeness and submit to the correct USCIS service center.

tasks.name: Confirm Eligibility and Basis
tasks.description: Confirm eligibility for adjustment (e.g., approved I-130/I-140, visa availability).

tasks.name: Document Gathering (Birth Cert, Medicals)
tasks.description: Collect birth certificate, passport, I-94, photos, and medical exam (I-693).

tasks.name: Prepare Supporting Forms (I-864, I-765)
tasks.description: Prepare supporting forms (I-864 Affidavit of Support, I-765, I-131).

tasks.name: Form I-485 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-485 with all personal history and admissibility questions.

tasks.name: Package Submission and Biometrics
tasks.description: Submit complete adjustment package. Prepare for biometrics appointment and interview.

tasks.name: Investment and Enterprise Setup
tasks.description: Identify/create new commercial enterprise and make the qualifying investment.

tasks.name: Source of Funds Documentation
tasks.description: Compile extensive documentation proving the lawful source of investment funds.

tasks.name: Business Plan and Job Creation
tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive business plan detailing job creation for at least 10 U.S. workers.

tasks.name: Form I-526 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-526 with all details of the investment, enterprise, and funds.

tasks.name: Submission and Tracking
tasks.description: Submit the petition with all supporting evidence and track USCIS receipt.

tasks.name: Regional Center Selection and Due Diligence
tasks.description: Conduct due diligence and select a designated USCIS Regional Center project.

tasks.name: Source of Funds Documentation
tasks.description: Compile extensive documentation proving the lawful source of investment funds.

tasks.name: Investment and Subscription Agreement
tasks.description: Make the qualifying investment and complete subscription agreements with the Regional Center.

tasks.name: Form I-526E Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-526E, referencing the Regional Center's project.

tasks.name: Submission and Tracking
tasks.description: Submit the petition with all supporting evidence and track USCIS receipt.

tasks.name: Confirm Eligibility and Timely Filing
tasks.description: Confirm eligibility and timely filing (before current status expires).

tasks.name: Gather Supporting Docs (I-94, Finances)
tasks.description: Collect I-94, passport, visa, and proof of financial support.

tasks.name: Form I-539 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-539, clearly explaining the reason for the request.

tasks.name: Co-Applicant Forms (I-539A)
tasks.description: If applicable, complete Form I-539A for each co-applicant.

tasks.name: Submission and Biometrics Prep
tasks.description: Submit application with fee. Prepare for biometrics appointment.

tasks.name: Co-Applicant Document Gathering
tasks.description: Collect co-applicant's personal information, passport, and I-94.

tasks.name: Form I-539A Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-539A for one co-applicant.

tasks.name: Review and Sign
tasks.description: Review form for accuracy and obtain co-applicant's signature.

tasks.name: Package with I-539
tasks.description: Combine signed I-539A with the primary I-539 application.

tasks.name: Identify Inadmissibility Grounds
tasks.description: Determine the specific grounds of inadmissibility (e.g., fraud, criminal).

tasks.name: Identify Qualifying Relative
tasks.description: Confirm a U.S. citizen or LPR spouse or parent as a qualifying relative.

tasks.name: Compile Extreme Hardship Evidence
tasks.description: Compile extensive evidence to prove extreme hardship to the qualifying relative.

tasks.name: Form I-601 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-601, detailing the inadmissibility and basis for the waiver.

tasks.name: Submission and Tracking
tasks.description: Submit waiver package with supporting hardship evidence and fee.

tasks.name: Confirm Eligibility
tasks.description: Confirm eligibility (unlawful presence only, approved I-130/I-140, U.S. relative).

tasks.name: Compile Extreme Hardship Evidence
tasks.description: Compile extensive evidence proving extreme hardship to U.S. citizen/LPR spouse or parent.

tasks.name: Form I-601A Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-601A.

tasks.name: Pay Department of State Fee
tasks.description: Pay Department of State immigrant visa fee and obtain receipt.

tasks.name: Submission and Biometrics
tasks.description: Submit I-601A package. Attend biometrics. Await decision before consular processing.

tasks.name: Find Civil Surgeon
tasks.description: Locate a USCIS-approved Civil Surgeon.

tasks.name: Gather Medical Records
tasks.description: Collect personal vaccination and medical history records.

tasks.name: Schedule and Attend Exam
tasks.description: Schedule and attend the medical examination.

tasks.name: Receive Sealed Envelope
tasks.description: Receive the completed, signed Form I-693 in a sealed envelope from the surgeon.

tasks.name: Submit with I-485
tasks.description: Submit the sealed envelope with the I-485 application or bring to the interview.

tasks.name: Confirm Petitioner Status
tasks.description: Verify petitioner's status as a refugee or asylee.

tasks.name: Gather Relative's Documents
tasks.description: Collect relative's (spouse/child) birth certificate, marriage certificate, and photos.

tasks.name: Compile Relationship Evidence
tasks.description: Compile evidence of the qualifying relationship (e.g., photos, correspondence).

tasks.name: Form I-730 Completion (within 2 years)
tasks.description: Complete Form I-730 within 2 years of petitioner's admission/asylum grant.

tasks.name: Submission and Tracking
tasks.description: Submit petition and supporting evidence. Await consular processing for beneficiary.

tasks.name: Check Filing Window (90 days)
tasks.description: Confirm filing window (90-day period before 2-year Green Card expires).

tasks.name: Gather Bona Fide Marriage Evidence
tasks.description: Collect joint documents (leases, bank statements, photos) from the last 2 years.

tasks.name: Form I-751 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-751 (jointly or with waiver request).

tasks.name: Package Assembly and Submission
tasks.description: Assemble package with I-751, evidence, and copy of Green Card. Submit to USCIS.

tasks.name: Biometrics and Interview Prep
tasks.description: Receive receipt notice (extends Green Card). Prepare for biometrics and potential interview.

tasks.name: Identify Need for Action
tasks.description: Determine need (e.g., duplicate approval, notify consulate, notify NVC).

tasks.name: Locate Approval Notice (I-797)
tasks.description: Find the original Form I-797 Approval Notice for the petition.

tasks.name: Form I-824 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-824, specifying the exact action requested.

tasks.name: Submission with Fee
tasks.description: Submit the form with the required filing fee and a copy of the approval notice.

tasks.name: Check Filing Window (90 days)
tasks.description: Confirm filing window (90-day period before 2-year conditional Green Card expires).

tasks.name: Gather Investment Sustained Evidence
tasks.description: Compile evidence that the full investment was sustained throughout the 2-year period.

tasks.name: Job Creation Documentation
tasks.description: Gather proof of job creation (payroll, I-9s) for 10 U.S. workers.

tasks.name: Form I-829 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-829 with details of the investment and job creation.

tasks.name: Submission and Biometrics Prep
tasks.description: Submit petition with all supporting evidence. Receive receipt and prepare for biometrics.

tasks.name: Identify Sponsor
tasks.description: Identify a petitioner/sponsor who meets 125% of the poverty guideline.

tasks.name: Gather Sponsor Financials (Tax Return)
tasks.description: Sponsor collects most recent federal tax return, W-2s, and proof of income/assets.

tasks.name: Form I-864 Completion
tasks.description: Sponsor completes Form I-864, including household size and income.

tasks.name: Review and Sign
tasks.description: Sponsor reviews and signs the legally binding affidavit.

tasks.name: Submit to NVC or with I-485
tasks.description: Submit the signed I-864 package with the I-485 or to the NVC.

tasks.name: Determine Reason for Replacement
tasks.description: Identify reason (e.g., lost, stolen, expired, incorrect).

tasks.name: Gather Supporting Docs
tasks.description: Collect copy of current Green Card (if available), passport, or proof of identity.

tasks.name: Form I-90 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-90, either online or paper.

tasks.name: Submission and Biometrics
tasks.description: Submit application with fee. Prepare for biometrics appointment.

tasks.name: Victim Narrative and Evidence
tasks.description: Compile detailed personal narrative of trafficking and any corroborating evidence.

tasks.name: Request Law Enforcement Declaration (I-914B)
tasks.description: Request I-914 Supplement B, Declaration from a Law Enforcement Agency (LEA).

tasks.name: Form I-914 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-914, detailing the facts of the trafficking.

tasks.name: Personal Statement (Helpfulness)
tasks.description: Write a personal statement demonstrating compliance with LEA requests (if over 18).

tasks.name: Submission and Tracking
tasks.description: Submit complete package. Prepare for potential RFE or interview.

tasks.name: Identify Eligible Family Members
tasks.description: Identify eligible family members (spouse, children, parents, siblings).

tasks.name: Gather Family Member Docs
tasks.description: Collect relative's birth certificate, marriage certificate, and photos.

tasks.name: Form I-914A Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-914A for each eligible family member.

tasks.name: Package with I-914
tasks.description: Combine I-914A forms with the principal I-914 application or file separately.

tasks.name: Identify LEA Contact
tasks.description: Identify the relevant Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) and a contact person.

tasks.name: Provide Case Information to LEA
tasks.description: Provide case details and trafficking information to the LEA.

tasks.name: Request Declaration Completion
tasks.description: Formally request the LEA official complete and sign the I-914B.

tasks.name: Follow-up and Obtain Signed Form
tasks.description: Follow up with the LEA and obtain the signed declaration.

tasks.name: Include with I-914 Application
tasks.description: Include the signed I-914B with the principal I-914 application.

tasks.name: Confirm Qualifying Crime
tasks.description: Confirm victimization from a qualifying criminal activity.

tasks.name: Obtain Law Enforcement Certification (I-918B)
tasks.description: Request I-918 Supplement B certification from a qualifying agency (police, prosecutor).

tasks.name: Write Personal Statement
tasks.description: Write a detailed personal statement describing the crime and helpfulness.

tasks.name: Form I-918 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-918 with personal details and crime information.

tasks.name: Submission and Tracking
tasks.description: Submit complete package (I-918, Supp B, statement). Await processing.

tasks.name: Identify Eligible Family Members
tasks.description: Identify eligible family members (spouse, children, etc.).

tasks.name: Gather Family Member Docs
tasks.description: Collect relative's birth certificate, marriage certificate, and photos.

tasks.name: Form I-918A Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-918A for each eligible family member.

tasks.name: Package with I-918
tasks.description: Combine I-918A forms with the principal I-918 application.

tasks.name: Identify Certifying Agency
tasks.description: Identify the LEA, prosecutor's office, or judge with knowledge of the case.

tasks.name: Provide Case Information
tasks.description: Provide case details, police reports, and evidence of helpfulness.

tasks.name: Request Certification
tasks.description: Formally request the agency official complete and sign the I-918B.

tasks.name: Follow-up and Obtain Signed Form
tasks.description: Follow up with the agency and obtain the signed certification (valid for 6 months).

tasks.name: Include with I-918 Application
tasks.description: Include the signed I-918B with the principal I-918 application.

tasks.name: Develop Organizational Structure
tasks.description: Form the legal entity for the Regional Center and define its structure.

tasks.name: Define Geographic Scope and Methodology
tasks.description: Define the proposed geographic scope and economic impact methodology.

tasks.name: Develop Business Plans and Projections
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive business plans and economic projections for proposed projects.

tasks.name: Form I-956 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-956 with all required operational and compliance details.

tasks.name: Submission and Fee
tasks.description: Submit the extensive application package with the required fee to USCIS.

tasks.name: Develop Project Business Plan
tasks.description: Create a detailed business plan for the specific capital investment project.

tasks.name: Commission Economic Impact Analysis
tasks.description: Commission an economic impact analysis detailing job creation.

tasks.name: Prepare Offering Documents
tasks.description: Prepare securities offering documents (PPM, subscription agreement).

tasks.name: Form I-956F Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-956F with all project-specific details.

tasks.name: Submission by Regional Center
tasks.description: The Regional Center submits the I-956F application to USCIS for project approval.

tasks.name: Gather Annual Data (Capital, Jobs)
tasks.description: Collect data on capital invested and jobs created/maintained for the fiscal year.

tasks.name: Review Compliance
tasks.description: Review all Regional Center activities for compliance with designation.

tasks.name: Form I-956G Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form I-956G, reporting on all investor and project activities.

tasks.name: Submission by Deadline
tasks.description: Submit the annual report to USCIS by the December 29th deadline.

tasks.name: Review Guide
tasks.description: Review the M-1087 guide for rules on B-1/B-2 medical treatment.

tasks.name: Document Gathering Plan
tasks.description: Create a plan to gather required documents (doctor's letter, proof of funds).

tasks.name: Consular Interview Prep
tasks.description: Prepare for consular interview questions based on the guide.

tasks.name: Review Guide
tasks.description: Review the M-1097 guide for an overview of the naturalization process.

tasks.name: Eligibility Self-Check
tasks.description: Use the guide to perform an initial eligibility check.

tasks.name: Study Plan Creation
tasks.description: Create a study plan for the civics and English tests.

tasks.name: Review Guide
tasks.description: Review the M-735 guide for OPT eligibility and application timelines.

tasks.name: DSO Coordination Plan
tasks.description: Plan coordination with the Designated School Official (DSO).

tasks.name: I-765 Prep List
tasks.description: Create a document checklist for the Form I-765 application.

tasks.name: Review Guide
tasks.description: Review the M-736 guide for SSN eligibility and application procedures.

tasks.name: Document Checklist
tasks.description: Create a checklist of required documents (passport, I-94, EAD).

tasks.name: SSA Office Visit Plan
tasks.description: Plan visit to a Social Security Administration (SSA) office.

tasks.name: Review Guide
tasks.description: Review M-737 for R-1 visa and I-360 religious worker requirements.

tasks.name: Organization Document Review
tasks.description: Check if the religious organization's documents meet guide standards.

tasks.name: Petition Prep Plan
tasks.description: Create a plan for preparing the R-1 or I-360 petition.

tasks.name: Review N-400 Denial Notice
tasks.description: Receive and review the Form N-400 denial notice.

tasks.name: Gather Counter-Evidence/Arguments
tasks.description: Gather new evidence or legal arguments to challenge the denial.

tasks.name: Form N-336 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form N-336, clearly stating the reasons for the appeal.

tasks.name: Submission (within 30 days)
tasks.description: Submit the N-336 with fee within 30 days of the denial decision.

tasks.name: Obtain Form N-426
tasks.description: Download the most current Form N-426.

tasks.name: Applicant Completion (Part 1)
tasks.description: Applicant completes Part 1 of the form.

tasks.name: Submit to Military for Certification
tasks.description: Submit the form to the appropriate military service branch for certification.

tasks.name: Receive Certified Form
tasks.description: Receive the certified N-426 back from the military.

tasks.name: Submit with N-400
tasks.description: Include the certified N-426 with the Form N-400 naturalization application.

tasks.description: Identify reason for replacement (lost, stolen, name change).

tasks.description: Collect proof of identity, photos, and evidence of the original document (if possible) or name change.

tasks.name: Form N-565 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form N-565.

tasks.name: Submission with Fee
tasks.description: Submit the application with fee and supporting documents.

tasks.description: Confirm eligibility (e.g., child of U.S. citizen, acquisition/derivation).

tasks.description: Collect parents' birth certificates, marriage certificates, and proof of U.S. citizenship.

tasks.name: Gather Applicant Docs
tasks.description: Collect applicant's birth certificate and proof of LPR status (if applicable).

tasks.name: Form N-600 Completion
tasks.description: Complete Form N-600 with all required biographic and parental information.
